rules.name: Q4 2026 5% Cashback Bonus categories: Restaurants, Entertainment, Utilities
rules.eligibility_notes: Restaurants: full-service restaurants, cafes, cafeterias, fast-food locations, caterers; restaurants inside hotels or retail stores and bakeries may not qualify. Entertainment: movie theaters, sports/theatrical/concert promoters, amusement parks, tourist attractions, aquariums, zoos, dance halls, record stores, video rental, pool halls, bowling alleys; excludes golf courses, country clubs, cable and streaming services, third-party amusement park tickets.
